newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares follow Wall Street to end lower.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares follow Wall Street to end lower.

text.p: Brazilian shares closed slightly down Friday, tracking the Dow Jones index which fell for a second straight session, brokers said.

The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 52 most-active stocks ended off 0.17 percent at 62,594 points, following Wall Street stock prices which closed off 0.56 percent on mounting worries over an increase in U.S. interest rates.
Market volume was a moderate 329.8 million reais ($324.4 million).
